positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: -Develop system models to emulate customer payloads, satellite interface boards and system behaviors to test against Flight Software image for product acceptance testing. Developed multi-threaded application to coordinate NGC Simics Softbench with multiple Simics payload applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked as a developer for IBM's Data Security product (Security Key Lifecycle Manager) which deals in Key Management and Encryption.

• Was responsible for developing various REST Services and modules including both backend and frontend using JavaEE, JavaScript and scripting languages like Shell.

• Subject Matter Expert in High Availability and Disaster Recovery solutions.

• (VAPT) Responsible for tackling Security Vulnerabilities and bullet proofing the product from security bugs and hacks. This includes code fixing and developing modules to prevent attacks as serious as SANS25.

• Major contributor in development and conformance of Key Management Interoperability Protocol (KMIP) with SKLM (Security Key Lifecycle Manager) for RSA conference every year.

• Technologies I currently work on include Java, HTML 5, Dojo (JavaScript based framework), Docker, Kubernetes, and XML.

• Architectural design and implementation of various Crypto modules for the product. Primary purpose behind this is to manage and secure all the cryptographic data with up to date and less vulnerable algorithms.

• Follow Agile Methodology for product development and delivery

• Apart from my primary role of a developer, I also worked as a Scrum master for the development team. Leading and managing all the Scrum related activities while ensuring that the team lives agile values and principles and follows the processes and practices
